svg.text: Hear every computer on your desk through one pair of headphones.

g.text: Local network only · no server · no account
UDP, straight from device to device
plus a copy of the 2 ms before it
Everyone together, about 20 ms behind real time
CD, Balanced and Saver for busy Wi-Fi.
15–30 ms of buffering. It grows during a
Wi-Fi stall and shrinks again after.
Listen privately with a code. Only devices
with it can join, and the audio is encrypted.
